'''Sil's Place''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located on the [[Westport]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The pubtender there was an operative of the group [[Whiplash]].<ref name="CN3">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref>
